areas.ag: Rhode Island Dept. of Environmental Management
areas.t: Clouds on Friday with southerly winds with heavy rain overnight. Air quality GOOD. Highs in the upper 60s. Chance of rain early Saturday. Clouds with north winds and temperatures in the mid 60s. Sunshine and good mixing on Sunday with steady NW winds and continued GOOD air quality.
